ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Mars

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and routine. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and family. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and conversations. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and money. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and your image. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and friendships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and your career. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and relationships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.
